comment: ANCHOR: INJECTION_TRIAGE_19_20261106 — SQL-injection triage batch 19 (tq-py-sql-fstring). The classification
validator binds each table name as a parameter instead of quoting it into the SQL; the strategy classifier's
symbol filter stays a literal ANY(%s) clause so a hostile symbol reaches params, never the SQL text.
Hermetic: a fake cursor records (sql, params); no database, no network.
